jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer - Supply Chain/Manufacturing (LSci)
jobs.description:
Join our AI & Engineering team
in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Recruiting for this role ends on 09/24/2026.

Work you'll do

As an AI and Data Science Engineer III
on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for driving technology-focused client delivery across complex engagements.

Deliver client engagements focused on artificial intelligence, data science, and analytics solutions across life sciences manufacturing, quality, supply chain, digital operations, and predictive maintenance
Design and implement scalable AI solutions, including generative artificial intelligence use cases, digital twins, scenario modeling, forecasting, and industrial optimization capabilities
Manage day-to-day interactions with client stakeholders and sponsors, acting as the primary technical point of contact for your workstreams
Lead teams through business requirements gathering, functional design, process mapping, and support-model definition, providing technical direction throughout
Develop and maintain project scope, schedule, and resource plans for your workstream, and adjust them as engagement needs evolve
Maintain clear, consistent communication with client stakeholders and internal engagement leadership

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our AI & Data practice offers comprehensive solutions for designing, developing, and operating advanced Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. We help clients innovate, enhance, and manage their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can grow and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

5+ years of consulting or industry technology experience delivering data, analytics, and artificial intelligence solutions for life sciences manufacturing, quality, supply chain, digital operations, or predictive maintenance
2+ years of hands-on experience with:
GenAI roadmap development and scaling use cases across functions or sites
Digital twins, scenario modeling, and industrial or manufacturing optimization
machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, forecasting, and model validation
programming in Python, SQL, PySpark, R

1+ years of experience leading, managing, and delivering workstreams or small teams with complex technical engagements with resources in multiple locations
Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or Operations Research
Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or Operations Research
Experience with cloud computing platforms, including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Experience developing materials for client workshops and interactive working sessions
Experience presenting technical content to small and large stakeholder groups

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. jobs.title: Survey Technician II
jobs.description:
Mark Thomas is hiring a Survey Technician II to add to our growing survey team! The Survey Technician II is a member of the project team able to independently and successfully prepare assigned deliverables on time and within budget. The Survey Technician II is responsible for performing additional and/or elevated project tasks and has the ability and proficiency to provide assistance to experienced technicians and licensed surveyors. Mark Thomas is a great place to grow your career - join us!

Responsibilities

Uses survey CADD software to assist in preparation of mapping plats, maps, descriptions, ALTA surveys and other deliverables, Topographic Mapping, Digital Terrain Models (DTM's), Point Databases, and calculations for field crews
Drafts legal descriptions and other survey documents
Assists licensed surveyors with resolving Right of Way/property boundaries by researching property information
Interprets maps and deeds necessary for creating accurate property descriptions
Peer reviews other technicians’ CADD mapping work
Generates records requests for utility information and maps existing utilities
Provides support related to storage, transportation, assembly, operation and maintenance of survey equipment and vehicles as needed
Completes training and attends meetings as assigned

Qualifications

High School diploma or equivalent; BS or AA with a survey or drafting emphasis preferred; equivalent experience considered in lieu of formal education
2-6+ years of relevant experience
Working knowledge of MS Office applications
Proficient in survey drafting software (AutoCAD, Civil 3D, MicroStation, TopoDOT, and Trimble Business Center (TBC), InRoads)
Basic knowledge of survey calculations, principles, terms and deliverables
Drafting/CADD certificates preferred
Demonstrates effective written and verbal skills
Ability to multi- task and prioritize tasks effectively
Ability to work and collaborate in a team environment
Ability to develop and maintain professional relationships with a variety of unique and diverse people and personalities

Benefits And Compensation

Mark Thomas offers a fantastic benefits and compensation package to include:

Competitive salary and incentives to include employee referral bonuses, certification and licensing incentives (PLA, PLS, PE, LSIT, EIT), and eligibility for year-end performance incentives
401k and ESOP retirement benefits to include profit sharing and a 401k match
Paid-time off benefits to include PTO, public holidays + additional holidays, bereavement leave, jury/civic time, licensing & certification exam time
Employer-paid vision insurance, basic life insurance, short-term & long-term disability, inclusive family planning & fertility resources, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), travel insurance, and in-house wellness education & challenges
Voluntary medical and dental insurance, life insurance, and pet insurance
FSA programs for medical, dependent care, commuter & parking
Reimbursements for certification and licensing exams and study classes and materials
Tuition reimbursement, paid annual dues for industry professional/societal organizations, memberships, and events
Budgeted time for training and career development
Flexible schedules and hybrid and primarily remote work environments

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. The successful candidate selected for hire will need to submit to a background check due to client relationship responsibilities and interactions required for this position following the extension of a conditional offer.

Mark Thomas is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Mark Thomas welcomes all.

jobs.title: Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst
jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Provide critical communications and tracking for multiple spacecraft from three complexes located globally, and operates year round 24 hours/7days to provide continuous contact with the spacecraft. The program fulfills NASA goals by supporting NASA deep space mission set, including NASA-funded missions and collaborative international missions.

About The Role

We are looking for a Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst
to support our Deep Space Network (DSN) Operations and Maintenance O&M contract with the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and NASA in Fort Irwin, CA.

What You'll Do:

As Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst, your primary responsibility is ensuring the safety of personnel working in and around complex antenna, mechanical, and electrical systems at a remote government facility. You will lead safety programs, investigate incidents, drive risk reduction, and maintain regulatory compliance across the full spectrum of EHS disciplines - with a clear emphasis on occupational safety first.

Core Safety Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve site safety programs, with emphasis on high-hazard work (electrical, elevated, confined space, heavy equipment)
Conduct and lead incident investigations; identify root causes and drive corrective actions to closure
Conduct hazard assessments, job safety analysis (JSAs), and Management of Change (MOC) reviews
Perform and lead EHS audits, field observations, and self-assessments; report findings to leadership
Lead or support emergency response planning and exercises
Analyze safety performance data (OSHA 300 logs, LTIR, frequency rates) and present trends to stakeholders

Training & Compliance:

Develop and deliver EHS training programs; certify trainers where applicable (OSHA 500/501)
Ensure compliance with federal and California regulations (OSHA, Cal/OSHA, EPA, Cal/EPA, NFPA, APCD)
Manage Air Quality and Water programs, including regulatory reporting and agency coordination
Prepare internal and external compliance reports, including data analysis and trend summaries

Collaboration & Communication:

Serve as the primary EHS point of contact for site management, trade personnel, and JPL/NASA stakeholders
Represent the program in discussions with regulatory agencies and community stakeholders
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior EHS staff

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

BS/BA + 8 years of experience; MS/MA + 6 years; PhD + 3 years; or 4 years of directly relevant experience in lieu of degree
Strong knowledge of OSHA, Cal/OSHA, EPA, NIOSH, NFPA, and APCD regulations; NASA familiarity is a plus
Demonstrated experience leading safety programs in complex industrial or government facility environments
Experience with construction safety oversight and managing shifting project priorities
Ability to analyze EHS data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Valid California driver's license (Read-ID)
U.S. citizenship required; must pass background check and NCIC screening

Preferred Qualifications:

Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or OHST/CHST (BCSP)
OSHA 500/501 Train-the-Trainer certification
Prior experience in government or DOD facility contracts

Details

Target Salary Range: $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:
Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Roofing Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Baker Home Energy we thrive off truly living our values - Do the Right Thing, Exemplify Our Reputation, Win Together, and Embrace Change and Growth.

We’ve been helping Southern Californians power their homes and live more comfortably since 1938. Today, we provide comprehensive home energy solutions including solar and battery, heating and cooling, roofing, electrical, plumbing and other essential home services. Our continued success is built on the experience and dedication of our people and a shared commitment to quality, service, and doing the job right. We’re looking for talented people who want to grow their careers while helping us deliver the trusted service Baker customers have relied on for generations.

The Roofing Project Coordinator is responsible for managing the daily administrative and operational support of the Roofing Department. This role oversees office personnel, permitting activities, project scheduling coordination, customer communication, vendor relationships, production documentation, and administrative processes that support efficient roofing operations. The Roofing Office Manager serves as the primary administrative leader for the roofing business and partners closely with Roofing Production, Sales, Service, and Finance teams to ensure projects move efficiently from contract execution through completion and closeout. Adapted from the Roofing Manager position structure provided.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Outcomes: Efficient administrative support of roofing production operations.

Manage daily administrative functions supporting roofing installations, repairs, reroofs, and service projects.
Develop and maintain department workflows, processes, and documentation standards.
Ensure roofing projects are properly set up, documented, and tracked through completion.
Monitor project administrative milestones, including Designs, BOMs, permits, inspections, material deliveries, and job closeout requirements.
Keep strong relationships with subcontractors and initiate all subcontracts
Identify process improvement opportunities to improve departmental efficiency and customer experience.

Scheduling & Production Coordination

Outcomes: Schedule accuracy and operational readiness.

Coordinate production schedules with Roofing Manager, Foremen, and Customers.
Coordinate, crew scheduling, material delivery coordination, and inspection scheduling.
Monitor job readiness and ensure required documentation is complete before project starts.
Communicate schedule changes and project updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Support project closeout and final documentation processes.
Work with service team to schedule roofing service calls
Manage all sub-contractors schedules and sub-contracts
Manage all project change orders with HO and sub-contractors

Permitting & Compliance

Outcomes: Timely permit and inspection management.

Oversee permit application, submission, tracking, and approval processes.
Coordinate inspections with local jurisdictions and regulatory agencies.
Maintain permit records and compliance documentation.
Ensure project files meet company and regulatory requirements.

Customer Service & Communication

Outcomes: Customer satisfaction and professional communication.

Serve as a primary point of contact for administrative customer inquiries.
Manage customer communications related to scheduling, project status, inspections, and project completion.
Assist in resolving customer concerns and escalations.
Ensure customers receive timely, accurate, and professional communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Support customer satisfaction initiatives and project follow-up.

Team Leadership

Outcomes: Administrative team performance and development.

Direct administrative coordinators, schedulers, permitting specialists, and office support personnel.
Establish departmental expectations and performance standards.
Support recruiting, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
Promote accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
Develop cross-training programs to improve departmental flexibility and support.

Vendor & Material Coordination

Outcomes: Administrative support of procurement activities.

Coordinate with suppliers, distributors, manufacturers, and vendors.
Support material ordering processes and delivery scheduling.
Track vendor performance and maintain vendor relationships.
Assist with invoice reconciliation and purchasing documentation.
Ensure project teams receive accurate material and delivery information.

Reporting & Department Support

Outcomes: Accurate reporting and administrative controls.

Prepare operational reports related to production, permitting, scheduling, and customer service metrics.
Maintain roofing department records and documentation.
Track departmental KPIs and assist leadership with performance reporting.
Support budget tracking and administrative cost controls.
Assist leadership with special projects and operational initiatives.

Success Measures

The Roofing Office Manager will be evaluated on:

Permit turnaround times
Scheduling accuracy
Customer satisfaction
Administrative quality and accuracy
Inspection pass rates
Job readiness performance
Project closeout cycle times
Office productivity
Employee development and retention
Internal stakeholder satisfaction

Compensation Range

The base pay for this position ranges from $26.00 to $36.00 per hour, based on experience.

Supervisory Repsonsibilities

None

Qualifications And Education

High school diploma or GED required; Operations Coordination, Construction Coordination, related experience preferred.
Minimum of 3 - 5 years of Roofing orientated experience in office administration, operations coordination, construction administration, or project support required.
Experience supporting roofing, construction, home improvement, solar, or related trades is strongly preferred.
Experience with permitting, scheduling, production coordination, and customer service preferred.
Valid driver's license preferred.

Knowledge And Abilities

Strong knowledge of roofing operations, construction administration, project coordination, scheduling, and permitting processes.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Excellent customer service and communication abilities.
Ability to work effectively with field operations, sales teams, vendors, customers, and leadership.
Ability to identify and resolve administrative bottlenecks before they impact project execution.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to process compliance

Technical Skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, Excel, Teams, and Word.
Experience with CRM, ERP, and construction management software.
Strong reporting, data management, and document control skills.
Ability to manage project documentation, permits, inspections, and scheduling systems.
Experience with digital workflow and document management platforms.

Behavioral Skills

Demonstrates leadership, accountability, professionalism, urgency, and follow-through.
Builds trust through reliability, communication, and customer focus.
Maintains a solution-oriented approach when managing competing priorities.
Collaborates effectively across departments.
Demonstrates ownership of departmental performance and customer experience.
Maintains high standards for organization, accuracy, and execution.

Work Environment

Primarily office-based with regular interaction with roofing field personnel, customers, suppliers, and local jurisdictions.
Occasional visits to jobsites, warehouses, and customer locations.
Frequent use of computers, scheduling software, phones, and office equipment.

Physical Demands

Standard office environment. Individual will frequently be required to stand, walk, sit, talk, and hear. Occasionally may have to lift boxes full of materials for purposes of setup of programs, typically 25 pounds or less. Periodic travel to jobsites and company facilities may be necessary.

Job Summary

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports. Execute, write, test, validate, analyze and distribute reports. Determine appropriate approach and tools needed to complete project in an efficient and timely manner. Collaborate with key stakeholders and senior analysts.

Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

TRC has an immediate opening for an Emissions Testing Environmental Scientist with our Air Measurement Services (AMS) Practice in the Exton, PA area. TRC Companies, Inc. is a national engineering consulting firm that provides integrated services to the energy, environmental and infrastructure markets.

Since the 1960's TRC has been working with clients to provide results they can rely on. Today TRC's AMS practice provides emission testing and ambient monitoring services at various industrial and power generation facilities around the globe. You will be working with some of the most experienced engineers and scientists in this field, as TRC's Project Managers average 20 years of experience in the emissions testing industry.

Responsibilities

Set up equipment or stations to monitor and collect pollutants from sites, such as smokestacks, manufacturing plants, or mechanical equipment
Monitor emission control devices to ensure they are operating properly and comply with state and federal regulations
Record test data and prepare reports, summaries, or charts that interpret test results
Prepare supporting documentation, such as, proposals, test protocols, and other compliance reports
Successful completion of all required training
Manage project execution while adhering to all applicable local, state and federal regulations and guidelines
Conduct sampling collections at facility emissions points in potentially adverse conditions, including poor weather and heights
Travel up to 70% as needed to various locations throughout the US and overseas, including weekends, holidays, and extended stay
Calculate amount of pollutant in samples or compute air pollution or gas flow in industrial processes, using chemical and mathematical formulas
Conduct data analysis and interpretation and provide test results and analyses to client group

Qualifications

Intermediate proficiency in Word, Excel, and Adobe
Unencumbered US driver's license and a clean driving record
Have high attention to detail, especially as related to safety and quality
Ability to regularly lift and carry up to 50lbs
Able to safely traverse ladders, stairs, etc. daily
Strong written and oral skills

Highly Competitive Candidates Will Demonstrate

Bachelor's Degree in a science or engineering discipline preferred
Previous experience leading teams in the field
QI certification in Groups I, II, III
Thorough understanding of EPA Methods 1-5, 6C, 7E, 10
Experience with methods & scope specific to utility (Pt.75) customers
Experience performing CEMS RATA's (40 CFR 60/75)
Current, valid US Passport

Benefits*: TRC offers a competitive benefit package consisting of:

Medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance.
401k package that includes both traditional and Roth IRA options and Company match.
Paid time off contingent upon full time or part time status and level of seniority (ranging from 15 to 25 days per year).
All full-time employees enjoy a minimum of 8 Paid Holidays per year.
TRC ensures that all employees, including those that work part-time, receive paid sick, family, and disability leave in accordance with the laws of their state of residence.
These benefits are applicable to US employees depending on their employment status (full time, part time, or temporary). TRC offers jurisdiction specific benefit packages for International and Puerto Rico employees.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At PDI Technologies, we empower some of the world's leading convenience retail and petroleum brands with cutting-edge technology solutions that drive growth and operational efficiency.

By “Connecting Convenience” across the globe, we empower businesses to increase productivity, make more informed decisions, and engage faster with customers through loyalty programs, shopper insights, and unmatched real-time market intelligence via mobile applications, such as GasBuddy. We’re a global team committed to excellence, collaboration, and driving real impact. Explore our opportunities and become part of a company that values diversity, integrity, and growth.

Role Overview

As a Senior Financial Data Analyst, you will transform financial and operational data into insights that support planning, performance management, and business decision-making. You will develop and maintain reporting, dashboards, data models, and automated analytics solutions that improve visibility into business performance and increase the efficiency of Finance processes. Working cross-functionally, you will translate complex business questions into data-driven analyses, identify trends and opportunities, and leverage automation and AI-enabled tools to strengthen reporting, forecasting, and financial insights.

Key Responsibilities

· Analyze complex financial and operational data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities that support business and financial decision-making.

· Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics solutions that provide clear visibility into financial and operational performance.

· Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytical needs and translate them into scalable data and reporting solutions.

· Build and maintain data models, reporting logic, business rules, and data definitions that support consistent and reliable financial analysis.

· Automate recurring reporting and analytical processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability across Finance.

· Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality analysis to ensure financial reporting is accurate, complete, and consistent across systems.

· Develop ad hoc analyses, forecasts, and scenario-based insights to support financial planning, performance reviews, and business decisions.

· Translate complex financial and operational data into clear, compelling insights and recommendations for leadership and business stakeholders.

· Identify and implement opportunities to improve Finance data, reporting processes, tools, and workflows.

· Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to accelerate analysis, improve reporting efficiency, identify trends, and enhance financial insights.

· Evaluate emerging AI, analytics, and automation capabilities and identify practical opportunities to apply them within Finance.

· Maintain documentation for key reports, metrics, data definitions, business rules, and analytical processes.

Qualifications

Qualifications

· Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

· 3+ years of experience in data analytics, financial analytics, business intelligence, FP&A analytics, or a related discipline.

· Strong experience analyzing complex financial and operational data and translating findings into actionable business insights.

· Experience developing dashboards, reporting solutions, and automated analytics using business intelligence and data visualization tools.

· Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with SQL and data visualization or business intelligence tools.

· Experience working with financial and operational data with an understanding of key financial metrics and business performance drivers.

· Experience with data modeling, data definitions, business rules, data validation, and reporting governance.

· Demonstrated ability to improve reporting and analytical processes through automation and process improvement.

· Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics, automation, or emerging technologies used to improve reporting, forecasting, and decision support.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently work through complex data and business questions.

· Strong communication and data storytelling skills with the ability to present complex information clearly to business stakeholders.

· Ability to independently manage complex work and multiple priorities with minimal supervision.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future. PDI Technologies is unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Behavioral Competencies

· Business Insight

· Manages Complexity

· Decision Quality

· Tech Savvy

· Drives Results

PDI is committed to offering a well-rounded benefits program, designed to support and care for you, and your family throughout your life and career. This includes a competitive salary, market-competitive benefits, and a quarterly perks program. We encourage a good work-life balance with ample time off [time away] and, where appropriate, hybrid working arrangements. Employees have access to continuous learning, professional certifications, and leadership development opportunities. Our global culture fosters diversity, inclusion, and values authenticity, trust, curiosity, and diversity of thought, ensuring a supportive environment for all.

jobs.title: Senior Construction Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Acting as a central point of communication between Project Managers, Field Technicians, and Superintendents, this role ensures all phases of electrical construction projects are executed efficiently, accurately, and in alignment with company standards. Other responsibilities include facilitating communication, coordinating resources, reviewing plans and schedules, and assisting with all aspects of project execution.

At PPC Partners
we believe in the Power to Serve
along with the Pursuit of Excellence.
As such the following values guide our behaviors: A Servant's Heart
- Focus on the Needs of Others, Wisdom
- Insightful, Integrity
- Honesty and Trustworthy, Courage
- Decisive and Confident in Others, Humility
- Modest and Respectful, Passion
- Unfailing Dedication

Project Coordination

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Obtain printing plans, specifications, and addendums for estimating and active jobs
Coordinate permits, inspections, digger's hotline tickets, and other site-related needs
Track job activity including materials, resources, equipment, and timelines
Compile needed information for material purchases, submittals, and operation & maintenance manuals as requested by Project Managers
Assist with close out documents and presentations
Support estimating tasks such as takeoffs and bid package preparation

Administration & Support

Type letters, reports, proposals, memos, and other documentation
Maintain organized documentation of active and archived projects
Maintain required records, filing systems, and routine reporting schedules

Customer & Vendor Relations

Communicate bid invitations, deadlines, and updates to clients and internal teams
Request vendor quotes and issue purchase orders as needed
Maintain detailed customer notes
Deliver consistent, high-quality service to customers, field personnel, and vendors
Ensure effective conflict management and professional communication

Billing & Financial Support

Prepare and process billing, change orders, and final invoices
Process insurance certificates, contracts, and claims per project and customer requirements
Track expenses and support cost monitoring and savings initiatives

Safety/Hazard Recognition & Elimination

Pre-plan and identify the methods to eliminate hazards daily by work task.
Execute skill in observing habits and hazards of others and bringing it to their attention.
Uphold safety as the most important goal of our company. Support goal of achieving zero accidents.
Promote and encourage open communication between field and office regarding all safety concerns, suggestions, improvements, and PPE needed.
Obtain safety training as expected by all company personnel.

Qualifications And Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Construction Management/Sciences, Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, Building Science, etc.), or related
Prior experience in contracting, engineering, construction management, or a related field preferred

Experience, Skill And Abilities

Positive safety attitude and personal integrity - both are non-negotiable
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams)
Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
Strong interpersonal skills; ability to interact with all levels of the company and customers
Capable of maintaining important information confidential
Ability to accurately multi-task in a fast-paced environment

Physical Requirements

Office environment, requiring sitting and standing and extended amounts of time using a computer/keyboard at a single workstation.

MetroPower is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Residency Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Founded in 1965, UC Irvine
is a member of the prestigious Association of American Universities and is ranked among the nation’s top 10 public universities by U.S. News & World Report. The campus has produced five Nobel laureates and is known for its academic achievement, premier research, innovation and anteater mascot. Led by Chancellor Howard Gillman, UC Irvine has more than 36,000 students and offers 224 degree programs. It’s located in one of the world’s safest and most economically vibrant communities and is Orange County’s second-largest employer, contributing $7 billion annually to the local economy and $8 billion statewide.

To learn more about UC Irvine, visit www.uci.edu.

The Department of Radiation Oncology at UC Irvine School of Medicine provides high-quality, compassionate care to those diagnosed with cancer who require radiation treatment as part of the course of their clinical management. The department is committed to advancing clinical care, education and research.

Team members are highly qualified radiation oncologists, radiation biologists, medical physicists, nurses, dosimetrists, radiation therapists, medical assistants and social workers. They are certified in their respective specialties and actively involved in national organizations that develop standards of care in their areas of expertise.

Under general direction, incumbent is responsible for management and coordination of all residency programs within the Department of Radiation Oncology. This includes policy interpretation, development/implementation of procedures to support effective and efficient operations of residency in the department, and to ensure compliance with Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME), Commission on Accreditation of Medical Physics Education Programs (CAMPEP) and University policies. Implements and maintains internal and external program management software. Ensures the fiscal viability for all aspects of the Program, including budgetary oversight, FTE allocations, reimbursement requests, etc. Serves as a resource to the Residency Program Director, Chair, Department Administrator, and residents. Acts as unit liaison to other affiliate sites. Participates in special projects as requested by the Chair, Department Administrator and/or other department leaders.

Your Role on the Team

Administration, coordination and support of department specific Graduate Medical Education (GME) and/or non GME programs for Residents in the Department of Radiation Oncology. Involves designing, conducting, promoting, evaluating and supporting health professions education programs in compliance with organizational objectives and nationally accepted accreditation standards and requirements. Supports learners (including but not limited to faculty, residents, clinical fellows, graduate or undergraduate learners, practicing or licensed professionals) in areas such as curriculum, teaching and learning activities, scheduling, core competencies, assessment and evaluations. Coordinates all activities associated with ongoing administration of health professional education programs.

Duties include full management and coordination of all ACGME & CAMPEP Education Programs within the departments’ Radiation Oncology and Medical Physics clinical training programs.

In conjunction with Physician Program Directors (PDs), leads all educational activities that support program curriculums and ensure the program requirements are compliant. Lead the planning of the program needs (e.g. strategic development, system implementation, processes, policy & procedure development and implementation) to meet program objectives. Is the key liaison among affiliate institutions, GME office, Residents and the Department. Serves as a member of various educational committees both internal and external to the Institution. Responsible for maintaining and/or updating programmatic goals/objectives, policy and guidance materials for all education programs. Provides full administrative support to the PDs and Residents as it relates to program-specific purchase requisitions, disbursement vouchers, travel/entertainment reimbursements via KFS. Manages and oversee program audits, surveys, training evaluations, meeting minutes, & other correspondences.

Serves as a backup for Senate and Non-Senate faculty recruitments, merit and promotion management and annual reviews. Oversees Faculty and Resident recruitment using various identified recruitment sites. Responsible for scheduling, onboarding and oversight of all Clinic Shadowers, including internal & external Medical Students, Student Researchers, Clerkship programs, etc.

Required

What It Takes to be Successful

Working knowledge of ACGME, CAMPEP & AAAPM program requirements.
Thorough knowledge of relevant policies and regulatory requirements.
Solid knowledge of health professions education program requirements.
Thorough knowledge of health professions education industry.
Advanced knowledge of administrative operations and functions.
Demonstrated ability to apply knowledge and skills to develop and implement complex processes and systems.
Excellent communication skills; including verbal, written and active listening. Service oriented and responsive to questions and requests.
Ability to interact in a professional, resourceful, and courteous manner.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Demonstrated ability to develop working relationships within department and with learners.
Excellent organizational skills, initiative, and demonstrated attention to detail.
Ability to work with extremely complex calendars / schedules required.
Extremely well organized and detail oriented.
Knowledge of educational technology and systems.
Ability to troubleshoot and triages related technology issues.
Investigative, data analysis, and reporting skills.
Ability to generate computer reports, checking for errors, correcting and submitting accurate reports.
Skills include entering, maintaining, extracting, and analyzing data in electronic systems.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Video Conferencing Platforms.
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
Minimum of 2 years in Healthcare Administration.

Preferred

Basic knowledge of Human Resource and/or Personnel Management including staff onboarding, timekeeping, labor relations, etc.
Experience working in a union-facing or labor-driven environment.
Experience managing multiple concurrent programs or a demonstrated ability to navigate two separate accrediting bodies and requirements.
Familiarity with UC-specific systems such as UCPath (payroll/HR), AP Recruit (Faculty recruitment), KFS (financial & travel management)
4+ years of relevant experience with focus on Graduate Medical Education and/or Human Resource Management.

jobs.title: Claims - Data Analyst I - III
jobs.description:
Make a difference with a career in insurance

At The Cincinnati Insurance Companies, we put people first and apply the Golden Rule to our daily operations. To put this into action, we’re looking for extraordinary people to join our talented team. Our service-oriented, ethical, knowledgeable, caring associates are the heart of our vision to be the best company serving independent agents. We help protect families and businesses as they work to prevent or recover from a loss. Share your talents to help us reach for continued success as we bring value to the communities we serve and demonstrate that Actions Speak Louder in Person®.

If you’re ready to build productive relationships, collaborate within a diverse team, embrace challenges and develop your skills, then Cincinnati may be the place for you. We offer career opportunities where you can contribute and grow.

Build your future with us

Our Claims Operations department is currently seeking a Claims Data Analyst I - III. A Claims Data Analyst is responsible for understanding and analyzing claims data, creating reports, completing data requests, identifying and interpreting data trends, and presenting results to stakeholders. This analyst will work closely with internal and external customers to translate business needs into clear requirements and deliver solutions. This role involves frequent collaboration with IT to enhance deliverables. As a Claims Data Analyst, the responsibilities scale with experience and proficiency, so the candidate can be expected to fulfill leadership roles on projects, mentor fellow team members, establish and maintain relationships with internal and external customers, and independently manage workload.

Starting pay:
The pay range for this position is $55,000 - $90,000
annually. Pay is based on the applicant’s education, experience, location, knowledge, skills and abilities. Eligible associates may also receive an annual cash bonus and stock incentives based on company and individual performance.

Be Ready To

participate in or lead meetings with customers to understand data and reporting needs
build strong relationships with Claims leadership and stakeholders
create routine and ad hoc reports based on requests throughout the organization
develop and validate reports, dashboards, and large-scale trending analyses
extract and validate information from multiple data sources
perform statistical analyses for projects and summarize results
identify trends in data and provide actionable insights
partner with IT to investigate data discrepancies, resolve data issues, document requirements, and test system enhancements
understand how claims data is transformed from a source system to multiple downstream systems, including how the data is used in legacy systems, agency/insured portals, and in corporate data warehouses
help define and improve reporting processes
independently review and interpret data requests and follow through with timely reporting
ensure accuracy and consistency of claims data across data sources
serve as a subject matter expert for Claims data on corporate-level projects
explore and implement new reporting tools and solutions
proactively find ways to improve and automate processes, keeping efficiency at the forefront of work efforts
participate in peer review and mentor other analysts, depending on experience

Be Equipped With

the ability to proactively identify, build, and maintain relationships with stakeholders
strong problem-solving skills
keen attention to detail
clear written and verbal communication skills
ability to present complex information in an understandable and compelling manner
fluency with advanced Microsoft® Excel functionality including pivot tables, Power Query, combination charts, vlookups, and complex calculations
experience with data analysis, reporting, and creating queries to extract data
knowledge of Power BI or other data visualization software preferred
ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines independently
quick to learn new technical concepts and adapt to change
focus on improving processes and finding efficiencies
experience with or willingness to learn Excel macros, VBA, or other common coding languages (i.e. SAS, SQL, or DAX, etc.)

Bring Education And Experience From

qualified candidates have earned a bachelor's degree in business, mathematics, statistics or information technology-related fields or related experience
preferred knowledge of insurance industry and risk management
professional insurance designations are preferred but not necessary
knowledge of statistical analyses
familiar with data models and tools like PowerPivot
preferably 2+ years hands-on experience with reporting tools like SAP Business Warehouse, Power BI, Cognos or other tools for analytics and reporting
experience using SAS, R, SPSS or other statistical packages is desirable

Enhance your talents

Providing outstanding service and developing strong relationships with our independent agents are hallmarks of our company. Whether you have experience from another carrier or you’re new to the insurance industry, we promote a lifelong learning approach. Cincinnati provides you with the tools and training to be successful and to become a trusted, respected insurance professional – all while enjoying a meaningful career.

Enjoy Benefits And Amenities

Your commitment to providing strong service, sharing best practices and creating solutions that impact lives is appreciated. To increase the well-being and satisfaction of our associates, we offer a variety of benefits and amenities. Learn more about our benefits and amenities packages.

Embrace a diverse team

As a relationship-based organization, we welcome and value a diverse workforce. We grant equal employment opportunity to all qualified persons without regard to race; creed; color; sex, including sexual orientation; religion; national origin; age; disability; or any other basis prohibited by law. Learn more about the Federal Employment Notices .

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.

The Data & Analytics team is building Compass International Holdings' analytical platform - the governed foundation the company runs on. As a Data Analyst, you'll go beyond traditional dashboards and ticket queues - you will work cross-functionally with internal teams and business partners to leverage that foundation, delivering recommendations that drive decision-making.

We #obsess about the opportunity
in front of our organization to continue building a transformative asset that unlocks insights for the company. We are looking for someone to join our team that shares in this enthusiasm and passion for leveraging data to make decisions.

At Compass You Will

Accelerate Decision-Making: Structure clear options and trade-offs that enable the business to act faster with clarity
Deliver High-Impact Narratives: Package complex findings into clear narratives that give business partners the evidence and confidence to make a decision
Unlock Data Value: Turn the organization's investment in data infrastructure into tangible business outcomes - ensuring data actively drives strategy
Bridge Insights to Strategy: Translate traditional business intelligence and data science assets into concrete recommendations for the business
Reframe Business Problems: Work within a project team to turn reactive requests into structured analytical questions
Work with Trusted Data: Use your technical skills to navigate centrally managed datasets - spending your time on analysis, not data wrangling

What We Are Looking For

Technical Baseline: Functional proficiency in SQL and basic Python (pandas/EDA) to self-serve from centrally managed datasets
Structured Problem Solving: Ability to break down ambiguous business questions, validate assumptions, and align on scope before diving into analysis.
Business Curiosity: Energized by partnering with business leads, curious about unit economics and commercial drivers, and passionate about connecting technical analysis directly to financial outcomes.
Clear Communication: Ability to package complex quantitative data into concise narratives that non-technical partners can act on immediately.
Ownership & Growth Mindset: A self-starter who takes full accountability for their work, consistently seeks feedback, learns from setbacks, and strives for continuous growth.
Highly Collaborative: Thrives in a cross-functional environment, partnering tightly alongside technical partners and business leads to achieve shared goals.

Compensation:
The base pay range for this position is $84,000-$94,000 annually; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses and restricted stock units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

Perks That You Need To Know About

Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

Do your best work, be your authentic self.

At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst I, Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
Our mission: e
liminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst within our Business Intelligence organization to work with our Medical Affairs team. The Medical Affairs team is dedicated to clinical improvement of our members and quality assurance of our providers. In this role, you will serve as a key cross-functional data partner working with Quality, Product, and the Chief Medical Officer. You will work closely with Medical Affairs leadership to define KPIs, track outcomes, and conduct exploratory analyses that drive strategic decision-making and program evolution. A key competency for this role is an exceptional ability to translate technical work and ideas into language that clinicians can easily understand. You’ll operate in a cross functional data team that includes data scientists and analytics engineers, all of whom are working towards this goal with you. This is a full time, remote position on our team reporting to the Associate Director, Analytics. Occasional travel may be required for company or team meetings/events.

What You’ll Do

Partner with the Medical Affairs team to define, refine, and evolve key metrics and KPIs as the program scales across new conditions and services.
Build, document, and maintain dashboards and data visualizations in business intelligence tools (ex: Omni & Hex) that empower non-technical users to monitor clinical outcomes and provider quality.

The Data Analyst works with complex educational data from multiple systems and sources. Responsibilities include collecting, validating, analyzing, and communicating data to support agency priorities. The position supports state and federal reporting requirements, including Perkins V accountability measures and other CTE performance indicators. This work helps ensure data accuracy, strengthen reporting systems, evaluate program effectiveness, and provide actionable information that supports student success.

Would you like to achieve success and fulfillment while helping improve the lives of Utah students?

jobs.description:
Primary Purpose Of Job

As a role within Food Bank’s Programs Team the purpose of this position is to coordinate, establish and support on-site emergency food programs with non-typical partners in various communities of need throughout New York City. The non-typical partners that this position supports include K-12 schools, colleges, youth programs and healthcare partners. This includes Food Bank’s Campus Pantry Program that enables K-12 schools, youth organizations and colleges throughout NYC to provide nutritious food resources to food insecure students and their household members, as well as Food Bank’s PantryRx healthcare-based food distribution program. Students and youth from food insecure households are not able to perform their best. This position enables Food Bank to engage schools in providing meals to those student households in need.

Beyond school-based locations, this role will support Food Bank’s PantryRx healthcare-based food distribution program in communities at high risk of food insecurity. Food Bank's work with healthcare providers addresses some of the key health issues that food insecure patients and their families face. The health care sector is becoming more aware of the impact between food insecurity and health outcomes, and Food Bank is working to deepen partnerships with this sector to improve food security and health. This position will also support integration and building partner capacity for additional anti-hunger efforts in Food Bank's suite of services (such as SNAP benefits outreach, financial empowerment, nutrition workshops, etc.), in collaboration with other internal teams.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Act as primary liaison providing technical assistance to schools, health care partners, and other community-based organization (CBO) partners to support implementation of on-site food distribution programs, including but not limited to on-going technical assistance to a portfolio of sites, on-site support visits, grant monitoring, and internal collaborations across Food Bank team — Citywide Travel Required;
Coordinate monthly operations at program locations, including logistics of ordering food, delivery, budget monitoring, and adherence to program goals and deliverables;
Facilitate partner engagement strategies, such as leading in-person partner engagement opportunities, sharing food bank program offerings and resources, and coordinating partner learning opportunities;
Coordinate grant compliance and reporting efforts, such as tracking grant expenditures, creating and distributing grant award letters, and organizing data and documentation needed for funder reports and updates;
Maintain data and records – collect and process program documentation and client stories, update databases and prepare monthly performance reports of services provided;
Support program planning and implementation, site recruitment, training and on-boarding, and program monitoring, in partnership with the Associate Director and other internal staff and teams;
Develop and maintain strong working relationships with partner staff and stakeholders to create, strengthen and expand partnership relationships;
Support and coordinate working relationships between other internal Food Bank teams such as Community Nutrition, Research & Evaluation, Food Distribution, Public Affairs and Benefits Access to implement additional anti-hunger initiatives at existing partner sites;
Serve as spokesperson/liaison to a variety of audiences including presenting at trainings, conferences, media events and community meetings;
Support Food Bank efforts to identify and secure funding sources to support existing and potential projects;
Coordinate with internal teams to identify sites for special visits (funder or media), schedule meetings and prepare site for successful demonstration of program impact;
Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree in public health/policy, organizing or related field, and 2-3 years of experience with program support required;

Demonstrated commitment to being a viable and collaborative member of a team focused on ending hunger;

new_jobs.title: Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst
new_jobs.description:
About Peraton

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Program Overview

Provide critical communications and tracking for multiple spacecraft from three complexes located globally, and operates year round 24 hours/7days to provide continuous contact with the spacecraft. The program fulfills NASA goals by supporting NASA deep space mission set, including NASA-funded missions and collaborative international missions.

About The Role

We are looking for a Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst
to support our Deep Space Network (DSN) Operations and Maintenance O&M contract with the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and NASA in Fort Irwin, CA.

What You'll Do:

As Lead Safety & Environmental Analyst, your primary responsibility is ensuring the safety of personnel working in and around complex antenna, mechanical, and electrical systems at a remote government facility. You will lead safety programs, investigate incidents, drive risk reduction, and maintain regulatory compliance across the full spectrum of EHS disciplines - with a clear emphasis on occupational safety first.

Core Safety Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve site safety programs, with emphasis on high-hazard work (electrical, elevated, confined space, heavy equipment)
Conduct and lead incident investigations; identify root causes and drive corrective actions to closure
Conduct hazard assessments, job safety analysis (JSAs), and Management of Change (MOC) reviews
Perform and lead EHS audits, field observations, and self-assessments; report findings to leadership
Lead or support emergency response planning and exercises
Analyze safety performance data (OSHA 300 logs, LTIR, frequency rates) and present trends to stakeholders

Training & Compliance:

Develop and deliver EHS training programs; certify trainers where applicable (OSHA 500/501)
Ensure compliance with federal and California regulations (OSHA, Cal/OSHA, EPA, Cal/EPA, NFPA, APCD)
Manage Air Quality and Water programs, including regulatory reporting and agency coordination
Prepare internal and external compliance reports, including data analysis and trend summaries

Collaboration & Communication:

Serve as the primary EHS point of contact for site management, trade personnel, and JPL/NASA stakeholders
Represent the program in discussions with regulatory agencies and community stakeholders
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior EHS staff

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

BS/BA + 8 years of experience; MS/MA + 6 years; PhD + 3 years; or 4 years of directly relevant experience in lieu of degree
Strong knowledge of OSHA, Cal/OSHA, EPA, NIOSH, NFPA, and APCD regulations; NASA familiarity is a plus
Demonstrated experience leading safety programs in complex industrial or government facility environments
Experience with construction safety oversight and managing shifting project priorities
Ability to analyze EHS data and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Valid California driver's license (Read-ID)
U.S. citizenship required; must pass background check and NCIC screening

Preferred Qualifications:

Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or OHST/CHST (BCSP)
OSHA 500/501 Train-the-Trainer certification
Prior experience in government or DOD facility contracts

Details

Target Salary Range: $80,000 - $128,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own.

EEO:
Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

new_jobs.title: Roofing Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
At Baker Home Energy we thrive off truly living our values - Do the Right Thing, Exemplify Our Reputation, Win Together, and Embrace Change and Growth.

We’ve been helping Southern Californians power their homes and live more comfortably since 1938. Today, we provide comprehensive home energy solutions including solar and battery, heating and cooling, roofing, electrical, plumbing and other essential home services. Our continued success is built on the experience and dedication of our people and a shared commitment to quality, service, and doing the job right. We’re looking for talented people who want to grow their careers while helping us deliver the trusted service Baker customers have relied on for generations.

The Roofing Project Coordinator is responsible for managing the daily administrative and operational support of the Roofing Department. This role oversees office personnel, permitting activities, project scheduling coordination, customer communication, vendor relationships, production documentation, and administrative processes that support efficient roofing operations. The Roofing Office Manager serves as the primary administrative leader for the roofing business and partners closely with Roofing Production, Sales, Service, and Finance teams to ensure projects move efficiently from contract execution through completion and closeout. Adapted from the Roofing Manager position structure provided.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Outcomes: Efficient administrative support of roofing production operations.

Manage daily administrative functions supporting roofing installations, repairs, reroofs, and service projects.
Develop and maintain department workflows, processes, and documentation standards.
Ensure roofing projects are properly set up, documented, and tracked through completion.
Monitor project administrative milestones, including Designs, BOMs, permits, inspections, material deliveries, and job closeout requirements.
Keep strong relationships with subcontractors and initiate all subcontracts
Identify process improvement opportunities to improve departmental efficiency and customer experience.

Scheduling & Production Coordination

Outcomes: Schedule accuracy and operational readiness.

Coordinate production schedules with Roofing Manager, Foremen, and Customers.
Coordinate, crew scheduling, material delivery coordination, and inspection scheduling.
Monitor job readiness and ensure required documentation is complete before project starts.
Communicate schedule changes and project updates to customers and internal stakeholders.
Support project closeout and final documentation processes.
Work with service team to schedule roofing service calls
Manage all sub-contractors schedules and sub-contracts
Manage all project change orders with HO and sub-contractors

Permitting & Compliance

Outcomes: Timely permit and inspection management.

Oversee permit application, submission, tracking, and approval processes.
Coordinate inspections with local jurisdictions and regulatory agencies.
Maintain permit records and compliance documentation.
Ensure project files meet company and regulatory requirements.

Customer Service & Communication

Outcomes: Customer satisfaction and professional communication.

Serve as a primary point of contact for administrative customer inquiries.
Manage customer communications related to scheduling, project status, inspections, and project completion.
Assist in resolving customer concerns and escalations.
Ensure customers receive timely, accurate, and professional communication throughout the project lifecycle.
Support customer satisfaction initiatives and project follow-up.

Team Leadership

Outcomes: Administrative team performance and development.

Direct administrative coordinators, schedulers, permitting specialists, and office support personnel.
Establish departmental expectations and performance standards.
Support recruiting, onboarding, training, coaching, and performance management.
Promote accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.
Develop cross-training programs to improve departmental flexibility and support.

Vendor & Material Coordination

Outcomes: Administrative support of procurement activities.

Coordinate with suppliers, distributors, manufacturers, and vendors.
Support material ordering processes and delivery scheduling.
Track vendor performance and maintain vendor relationships.
Assist with invoice reconciliation and purchasing documentation.
Ensure project teams receive accurate material and delivery information.

Reporting & Department Support

Outcomes: Accurate reporting and administrative controls.

Prepare operational reports related to production, permitting, scheduling, and customer service metrics.
Maintain roofing department records and documentation.
Track departmental KPIs and assist leadership with performance reporting.
Support budget tracking and administrative cost controls.
Assist leadership with special projects and operational initiatives.

Success Measures

The Roofing Office Manager will be evaluated on:

Permit turnaround times
Scheduling accuracy
Customer satisfaction
Administrative quality and accuracy
Inspection pass rates
Job readiness performance
Project closeout cycle times
Office productivity
Employee development and retention
Internal stakeholder satisfaction

Compensation Range

The base pay for this position ranges from $26.00 to $36.00 per hour, based on experience.

Supervisory Repsonsibilities

None

Qualifications And Education

High school diploma or GED required; Operations Coordination, Construction Coordination, related experience preferred.
Minimum of 3 - 5 years of Roofing orientated experience in office administration, operations coordination, construction administration, or project support required.
Experience supporting roofing, construction, home improvement, solar, or related trades is strongly preferred.
Experience with permitting, scheduling, production coordination, and customer service preferred.
Valid driver's license preferred.

Knowledge And Abilities

Strong knowledge of roofing operations, construction administration, project coordination, scheduling, and permitting processes.
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced production environment.

The Analyst provides analytical support for all departments, including analysis, pricing, capitation, network and provider specific reporting. Analytical support includes creating and executing beginner and intermediate level reports and programs and programming modifications to previously written reports.
